==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this skill whenever it is charged.

== Notes ==
* This skill requires exactly 220 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 8 strikes and 20 units.

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] appears to display a female warrior wearing [[Warrior Gladiator armor|Gladiator Armor]].
* This causes one of the longest [[knock down]]s of any player-usable skills.
